That single URL matches the input row on FIVE facts at once - name + specialty (orthopaedics) + hospital (Yashoda) + branch (Secunderabad) + city (Hyderabad). Searched both the initialism and 'Newton + orthopaedics + Yashoda' as instructed; the only other 'Newton' orthopaedic surgeons surfaced are US-based (J. Tyler Newton, Denison TX; John Newton DO; Alan Newton, historical Canadian surgeon; Newton MA practices) and are plainly not him - no same-name Indian rival appeared, so there is no merge risk. The named hospital DOES publish a per-doctor profile, so this is NOT the stale-affiliation pattern. Band is Medium, not High, deliberately: every official corroboration sits on ONE domain, yashodahospitals.com (his doctor page, the orthopaedics department index, the orthopaedic team page and four 'best-doctors' topic pages) and per the brief several pages on one hospital domain is still one official domain. All other hits - Skedoc, HexaHealth, Ortil, MyMedTrip - are corroborating-only aggregators. NO email or phone recorded: Yashoda publishes no per-doctor line, no institutional address for him appeared verbatim anywhere, and the aggregator listings carry call-tracking/booking numbers which the brief instructs rejecting outright, so both contact fields are blank rather than guessed. No LinkedIn, ORCID, Google Scholar, ResearchGate, personal site or professional social account appeared; per the brief, absence of scholarly IDs is the normal result for Hyderabad private consultants and only one query was spent in that direction. One caution for a human: a search summary for the broader 'Newton orthopedic Yashoda' query asserted his expertise is 'Paediatric orthopaedic and Deformity Correction', while the summary on the name-exact query said trauma/arthroplasty/arthroscopy plus sports injuries and robotic joint replacement. Summaries are unstable and those two are inconsistent, so the specialization field records only the conservative, repeatedly-stated version (trauma, arthroplasty, arthroscopy); the paediatric-deformity claim is deliberately NOT recorded. Note also a domain trap avoided: yashodahospital.org and yashodahealthcare.com appeared in results but are unrelated hospitals in Nepal/Delhi-NCR, not this group's yashodahospitals.com.
